reviewed_by: Claude: retry a Butler check on another account after a usage limit
reason: Backend-only fix in butler_recovery.py. A background Butler check runs on the host project's Butler chat account; for Claude accounts nothing routed around a spent plan, so every Nebula-wide check hosted by a project whose Butler chat was on that account ended interrupted (live 2026-11-25..27). Now a check turn that fails on a usage or rate limit (is_rate_limit_failure) runs once more on another enabled same-kind account offering the model, with children moved off the spent account. Selected the Butler instructions suite (new regression test plus the Codex capacity-selection test that shares the refactored candidate filter), the global-check scope suite (roster privacy follows the running account) and the check-summary suite.
exclusions: No UI, frontend, Playwright or native change. Full suites not run. test_butler_global_check_scope.py hangs at interpreter exit after all tests pass, identically on origin/main.
